title: Левит 13 — Leviticus 13
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: The priest will examine the sore spot.
cases.explain: Место is the direct object of осмотрит (will examine) → accusative; for an inanimate neuter noun the accusative equals the nominative form место.

cases.translation: …the sore has gone deep into the skin.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into something takes the accusative → кожу.

cases.translation: The sick person must be brought to the priest.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/towards) always takes the dative → священнику.

cases.translation: …let him isolate him for another seven days.
cases.explain: Numbers five and above (семь) govern the genitive plural → дней.

cases.translation: …the disease covers the sick person from head to foot.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning "from" takes the genitive → головы.

cases.translation: …he must go about with his hair loose.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning "with" takes the instrumental → волосами (instrumental plural).

cases.sentence: Если больное место находится у мужчины или женщины на ___ или подбородке…
cases.translation: If the sore is on a man's or woman's head or chin…
cases.explain: The preposition на marking a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → голове. Compare question 5, where с "from" took the genitive головы.

cases.translation: …which broke out where there had been a boil.
cases.explain: Нарыв is the subject of был (there was) → nominative, the dictionary form.

reading.ru: Осмотрев больного, священник объявит его нечистым.
reading.question: What does the priest do after examining the infected person?
reading.explain: "Having examined the sick man, the priest shall pronounce him unclean."

reading.ru: Больной выстирает одежду и будет чист.
reading.question: What must the person do once the priest declares the spot a simple rash?
reading.explain: "The sick man shall wash his clothes and be clean."

reading.ru: Пока он болен, он будет нечистым, он должен жить один за пределами лагеря.
reading.question: Where must a person with the infectious disease live?
reading.explain: "As long as he is sick he is unclean; he must live alone outside the camp."

reading.ru: Больной с такими признаками должен носить разорванную одежду и должен ходить с распущенными волосами, с закрытой нижней частью лица и кричать «Нечист! Нечист!».
reading.question: What must the leprous person cry out?
reading.explain: The afflicted person must wear torn clothes, let his hair hang loose, cover his lip and cry "Unclean! Unclean!"

reading.question: What must be done with a garment suspected of mildew?
reading.explain: "The thing must be shown to the priest" for him to inspect the mildew.

reading.ru: Пусть он сожжет зараженную одежду, тканую или вязаную материю из шерсти или льна, или кожаную вещь, потому что это растущая плесень.
reading.question: What must be done with a garment that has a spreading mildew?
reading.explain: Because it is a growing (destructive) mildew, the infected garment must be burned.
